## Outcome

Describe the user or operational outcome and its alignment with `PRODUCT_VISION.md`.

## Governance gates

- [ ] **Capability discovery:** I traced existing code, configuration, tests, and docs and identified what is reused.
- [ ] **Necessity:** I explained why new code is required—or why this is a no-code/data/docs change.
- [ ] **Contracts:** I named and preserved or deliberately migrated governing interfaces and invariants.
- [ ] **Source of truth:** I changed canonical artifacts and regenerated or synchronized dependents.
- [ ] **Architecture:** The change follows permitted layers and dependency direction.
- [ ] **Security:** Initial controls and negative cases are implemented, not deferred.
- [ ] **Scope:** In-scope and out-of-scope behavior is explicit.
- [ ] **Drift:** Divergent representations are generated, updated atomically, or checked.
- [ ] **Completion:** Requirements map to direct evidence and required checks passed.
- [ ] **Exceptions:** None, or approved unexpired IDs are listed below.
